description: Civgraph source ledger: each source Civgraph holds or plans to hold, whether it is mirrored and where, what has been extracted from it, and what remains. Validated by npm run check:source-ledger; docs/source-ledger.md is generated from it.
policy: Published with the site, so it lists only sources whose content Civgraph may make public: open licences (OGL, OPL, Creative Commons, CC0, ODbL, Irish PSI open terms), Crown or state copyright that has expired, the public domain, and Civgraph's own or contributed work. Sources held or consulted under any other terms are tracked privately and are not listed here.
